title: NCVD toolbox: Nonlinear Characteristic Value Decomposition for Python and MATLAB
description: Nonlinear Characteristic Value Decomposition (NCVD) for Python and MATLAB: exact state-rate modal decomposition, FIR pole correction, ensemble and amplitude-dependent identification of nonlinear systems (backbone curves, frequency-energy dependence), and reduced-order-model diagnostics. Developed at the Nonlinear Dynamics Laboratory, University of Rhode Island. Builds on and replicates Li, Stein and Chelidze, Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing 222 (2025) 111769. Version 1.1 adds NCVD under an arbitrary linear operator (derivative, shift and spatial forms), residual diagnostics that localize and classify the nonlinearity, and iterative refinement; 1.1.1 adds forced modal analysis on the canonical path; 1.1.2 adds opt-in tracking remedies (numerical-rank rule, energy seeding, separate harmonic and zero-frequency pole families, identity-preserving matching with explicit gaps, strict closure, windowed()) and leaves every default result of 1.1.1 unchanged.
